module.purpose: Defines validated API input DTOs for rescheduling regular and seated bookings, including the new start time, optional rescheduler identity, reason, and seat identifier.
module.summary: This file provides two NestJS request models for booking rescheduling operations. Decorators expose OpenAPI documentation and enforce ISO date, string, optionality, and email-format validation. The seated-booking variant extends the shared rescheduling data with a required seat UID, while a reusable documentation constant explains confirmation behavior based on the rescheduler email.
module.businessContext: Supports customers and operators changing booking times while preserving confirmation and seat-specific requirements. Incorrect validation could permit malformed reschedules or prevent valid booking changes.
classes: RescheduleBookingInput_2024_08_13 (~L9-31): Validated booking rescheduling request with optional actor and reason.
RescheduleSeatedBookingInput_2024_08_13 (~L33-55): Validated seated-booking rescheduling request requiring a seat identifier.
systemCapabilities: Require seat identity for seated bookings

fileConstants.name: RESCHEDULED_BY_DOCS
fileConstants.value:
`Email of the person who is rescheduling the booking - only needed when rescheduling a booking that requires a confirmation.
If event type owner email is provided then rescheduled booking will be automatically confirmed. If attendee email or no email is passed then the event type
owner will have to confirm the rescheduled booking.`
